chunks.text: 2025 BMW M3 Competition sports sedan. Performance specs: Engine: 3.0L twin-turbo inline-6 (S58). Horsepower: 503 hp. Torque: 479 lb-ft. 0-60 mph: 3.4 seconds. Top speed: 180 mph. Drivetrain: RWD. Transmission: 8-speed M Steptronic automatic. Fuel economy: 16 city / 23 highway MPG.

2025 BMW M3 Competition sports sedan. Industry rankings and awards: Ranked 2nd of 18 in sports sedans by US News (2025), score 91/100. Praised for driving dynamics and engine character. Docked for infotainment learning curve. Ranked 1st of 12 in luxury sports cars by Car and Driver (2025), score 88/100. Editors choice award winner for the third consecutive year. Ranked 8th of 20 in reliability by Consumer Reports (2025), score 74/100. Above average reliability for the segment. Electrical system historically the weak point. Ranked 4th of 15 in resale value by Kelley Blue Book (2025), score 82/100. M3 retains value well, especially Competition trim. Limited supply supports residuals.

2025 BMW M3 Competition sports sedan. Expert reviews: Car and Driver (2025) rated it 9/10. The M3 Competition remains the benchmark sports sedan. The S58 engine is a masterpiece of forced-induction engineering. Pros: Extraordinary engine, razor-sharp chassis, usable daily driver. Cons: Divisive styling, complex iDrive menus, firm ride on rough roads. Motor Trend (2025) rated it 9/10. No sports sedan does more things better. The Competition is worth the premium over the base M3. Pros: Best-in-class lap times, excellent build quality, strong resale. Cons: Premium fuel required, insurance costs are high, rear tires wear quickly. Consumer Reports (2025) rated it 7/10. Performance is exceptional but reliability scores keep it from the top spot. Ownership costs are significant. Pros: Driving experience, brand prestige, strong residuals. Cons: Above-average repair costs, some owners report electrical gremlins.

2025 BMW M3 Competition sports sedan. Features and trim levels: Standard features include: M sport seats with memory, adaptive M suspension, carbon fiber interior trim, head-up display, launch control, M Drive modes, Harman Kardon surround sound, wireless Apple CarPlay, parking assistant. The Base M3 trim is priced at $72,800 . Added features: M sport seats, adaptive suspension, launch control. The Competition trim is priced at $76,900 and adds 30hp over base. Added features: high-rev engine tune, M carbon bucket seats, enhanced cooling. The Competition xDrive trim is priced at $80,900 and adds 30hp over base. Added features: all-wheel drive, winter performance package. The CS trim is priced at $119,900 and adds 40hp over base. Added features: carbon roof, ceramic brakes, track-tuned suspension, lightweight wheels.
